programme.title: The Comic
programme.desc: 1969. Comedy/Drama. Directed by Carl Reiner. Stars Dick Van Dyke, Michele Lee & Mickey Rooney. The intriguing story of an exceptional silent-film comic whose talent is overshadowed by his ego.

programme.title: The Disappearance of Flight 412
programme.desc: 1974. Sci-fi. Directed by Jud Taylor. Stars Glenn Ford & Bradford Dillman. When Flight 412 witnesses the disappearance of two fighter jets, a military group attempts to cover up the incident.

programme.title: Blood On The Sun
programme.desc: 1945. Thriller directed by Frank Lloyd and starring James Cagney and Sylvia Sidney. A dedicated American reporter in 1930s Japan is determined to expose the government's plan for world domination.

programme.title: Derek Fowlds: Jobbing Actor
programme.desc: Best known for The Basil Brush Show, Yes Minister and Heartbeat, Derek Fowlds looks back at his 60 year career and recalls many of the famous names and productions that he's been associated with.

programme.title: The Man Who Changed His Name
programme.desc: 1934. Drama. Lyn Harding plays Shelby Clive, who has been obliged to shorten his last name so that he won't be confused with a notorious (and never-apprehended) wife murderer.

programme.title: Law Of The Plainsman
programme.desc: 1960. Passenger To Mescalero. Stars Michael Ansara, Brian G. Hutton & Richard Gaines. Whilst transporting a prisoner, Sam is ambushed and must save the other passengers, and deliver the convict.

programme.title: Tufty Club Match Safety
programme.desc: A wonderful short animation with some wise words from Tufty on matches.

programme.title: The Stars Look Down
programme.desc: 1939. Directed by Carol Reed. Starring Michael Redgrave and Margaret Lockwood. Davey Fenwick leaves his mining village on a university scholarship intent on returning to better support the miners.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Southern Fishing Competition/Rabbit Catching. 1981. Jack takes us to Cork in Ireland for the final of the annual sea angling competition. He then goes hunting rabbits with a coney dog he has bred.

programme.title: Target Earth
programme.desc: 1954. Sci-Fi. Directed by Sherman A. Rose. Starring Richard Denning. A large city is ordered to be completely evacuated as an army of robots, believed to be from the planet Venus, attack it.

programme.title: Behemoth The Seamonster
programme.desc: 1959. Sci-Fi. Atomic marine tests cause the resurrection of a dormant sea-monster who then threatens to destroy London.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: In Police Hands. 1974. Stars Brigid Erin Bates, John Oxley & Douglas Fielding. Julie and Dave are happy, then they're in the nick. It seems that simply being in love these days is a crime.

programme.title: Forbidden
programme.desc: 1949. Drama. Directed by George King. Stars Douglass Montgomery, Hazel Court & Patricia Burke. An ex-serviceman plans to escape his faithless wife.

programme.title: The Wicked Lady
programme.desc: 1945. Drama. Directed by Leslie Arliss. Stars Margaret Lockwood, Griffith Jones & James Mason. 17th Century beauty Barbara Worth leads a double life to relieve her boredom.

programme.title: Oliver Twist (1982)
programme.desc: 1982. Drama. Director: Clive Donner. Stars George C. Scott, Tim Curry & Michael Hordern. The classic tale of an orphan boy who finds himself joining a band of thieves after escaping the orphanage.

programme.title: The Weaker Sex
programme.desc: 1948. War. Director: Roy Ward Baker. Stars Ursula Jeans, Cecil Parker, Derek Bond & Thora Hird. Martha tries to keep her home running as normal during the run up to the D Day landings.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1955. Night Plane to Amsterdam. Director: Ken Hughes. Stars Gerald Case, Shay Gorman, Selma Vas Dias & Andreas Malandrinos. The case of a murder which baffled the police of two countries. (S1, E11)

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro opens the Cellar Club for more Doomwatch and another chilling feature film. First up is Doomwatch - The Human Time Bomb, about a case study of tower block life.

programme.title: Doomwatch
programme.desc: The Human Time Bomb. 1971. Stars Jean Trend, Roddy McMillan & Patrick Godfrey. Dr Fay Chantry performs a biological study of tower block life - and finds far more than she expected.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Torment and terror are invited down into the Cellar Club as next up is the 1945 horror The Woman Who Came Back - a chilling story about witchcraft, suspicion and hysteria.

programme.title: The Woman Who Came Back
